task into smaller, deterministic steps that can be handled by the model
without requiring the model to make decisions. This includes providing
clear guidance on how to handle ambiguous or complex parts of the task, as
well as providing feedback and explanations to the user. The model should
also be trained on a variety of examples to improve its ability to
generalize its knowledge and apply it in different contexts.
